title: Comprehensive Node-Semver Rewrite, Verification, Fuzzing & Multi-Target Benchmark
goal: Re-implement node-semver in LIN Native Workflow (@LIN:L2w:1.0), proving 100% test-suite parity, fuzzing robustness, sub-microsecond parsing, 0% over-invalidation across 100 mutations, and compile-time rejection of adversarial optimizations.

modules_under_test.name: Comparison Matrix (gt, lt, eq, neq, gte, lte, cmp, rcompare)
Range Satisfaction Engine (hyphen, tilde, caret, wildcard, x-range)
Version Incrementing (major, premajor, minor, preminor, patch, prepatch, prerelease)

campaigns.name: 1. Official node-semver Test Suite Parity (1,480 test vectors)
2. High-Entropy Fuzzing (100,000 synthetic malformed & edge inputs)
3. Throughput, Cold Start, and Memory Benchmark vs Original JS
5. Adversarial Speedup Defense (Compiler Gate Rejection on Contract Stripping)
